coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using 17 ground-truth items (individual listed values plus scalar variables), 11 match (65%): AdvBench, three of five models, both SSP settings, AutoDAN and PAIR, a fixed PAIR budget, and string-based and GPT-based ASR evaluation.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Missing MaliciousInstruct, the constant JailTrickBench framework, Vicuna-7B, Qwen1.5-7B, AutoDAN suffix lengths of 10–100 tokens, and ASR averaging over 3–5 runs. The output combines evaluation methods into an ensemble rather than clearly reporting separate ASRPrefix and ASRAgent metrics. It also introduces unsupported datasets, attacks, adaptivity conditions, and utility metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits the observed reduction in ASR with safety system prompts and all model-specific AutoDAN and PAIR results.
